# Flood Solutions inc

> 24/7 restoration services in Macomb, MI.

Flood Solutions inc (Flood Solutions inc) is a professional restoration contractor serving Macomb, MI and surrounding areas since 1996. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (586) 580-0197 · Email: cgeatches@yahoo.com.
